About this Event

Join us at the Great Bridal Expo®—the nation’s longest running wedding show—for an exciting day of wedding planning all in one place!
Meet top local wedding professionals, explore the latest trends, and discover everything you need to bring your dream wedding to life. From stunning venues and photographers to florists, DJs, gowns, and more—you’ll find inspiration and exclusive show-only offers to help you plan with confidence and ease.
Enjoy live entertainment, a high-energy runway fashion show, and the chance to connect face-to-face with experts who can turn your vision into reality.
Whether you're newly engaged or finalizing details, the Great Bridal Expo® is your one-stop destination for ideas, inspiration, and unbeatable savings.
Register now and start planning your perfect day!
